definitions.explanation: An ancient Chinese system of geomancy that arranges spaces and structures to harmonize with the flow of energy ({気|き}). Widely practiced in Japan for decisions about home layout, building orientation, and interior design.

examples.japanese: {風水|ふうすい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{気|き}にする→気にする：03026_kinisuru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many people pay attention to feng shui.

examples.japanese: {風水|ふうすい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{玄関|げんかん}→玄関：05003_genkan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{運気|うんき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧。
examples.english: In feng shui, keeping the entrance clean is said to improve your fortune.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{建|た}てる→建てる：01189_tateru⟧とき、{風水|ふうすい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{専門家|せんもんか}→専門家：03088_senmonka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{間取|まど}り→間取り：06078_madori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: When building our new house, we had a feng shui expert look at the floor plan.

notes:
Literally ⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧ (wind) + ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧ (water). In Japan, feng shui is widely known and influences home and office layout choices, though the level of belief varies.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {風水|ふうすい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{気|き}にする→気にする：03026_kinisuru⟧ (care about feng shui)
- {風水|ふうすい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ (evaluate using feng shui)
- {風水|ふうすい}{師|し} (feng shui master)
- {風水|ふうすい}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (from a feng shui perspective)

USAGE:
In Japan, {風水|ふうすい} has merged with native directional beliefs such as {鬼門|きもん} (the unlucky northeast direction). Popular magazines and TV programs often feature simplified feng shui tips for home decoration and daily life. The related concept {家相|かそう} (house physiognomy) is a Japanese adaptation of similar principles.
